mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. This mechanism operates without threshold conditions as the rate change is continuously monitored.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of the months when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% within the past month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of the months when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past month indicate an emerging recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of the months where INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% and UNRATE rises by at least 0.2% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), a rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation, prompting further rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In months with FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of the months when CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.2% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past month indicates strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of the months when PAYEMS increases by at least 100k over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 2000.0 thousand units within the past two months signals a weakening real estate market, reducing consumer wealth and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of the months when HOUST falls below 2000.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months and 1 month, respectively, indicate a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of the months when GDPC1 growth (q/q) is negative and RSAFS declines by at least 0.3% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and UNRATE < 4.5%), a rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressures, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In months meeting the late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and UNRATE < 4.5%), SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of the months when CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.2% over the prior month.
